related_issues.reason: Open enhancement requesting that uv.lock support different index URLs across developer machines and CI; same underlying need (overriding the lockfile's recorded index at install time).

rationale: With --frozen, uv uses uv.lock as-is without re-resolving, so index settings such as UV_DEFAULT_INDEX and UV_INDEX_STRATEGY do not take part in resolution; the locked registry URLs are used for download. This follows from how frozen syncs work and I found no documented guarantee that the env vars rewrite locked URLs, so it is not clearly a bug. The reporter wants the lockfile index overridden by the env var, which matches open enhancement #6349. Searches turned up no exact duplicate. I did not read the sync or index docs page in full, so confidence is medium.
